subject.name: Mining (Metis DAC staking/mining contract)
subject.source_official_repo: https://github.com/MetisProtocol/Metis-Mining (contracts/Mining.sol; identical to deployed source, whitespace-only diff)

principal_invariant.method: Batched eth_call userInfo(pid,user) at pinned block for all 4850 unique participants (9700 calls, JSON-RPC batches of 100)
principal_invariant.conclusion: Contract METIS balance equals the sum of all userInfo[_pid][user].amount exactly, wei for wei. No excess, no deficit, no unaccounted METIS.

event_history.source: Blockscout v1 getLogs filtered by topic0 + v2 logs pagination; deduped by (txHash, logIndex)

emergencyWithdraw_pid1_top_holder_eth_ca.result: 0x (success, would transfer 2000 METIS back to the holder)

pendingMetis_top_holder.note: Paid by DACRecorder vault (sendRewardToVault), NOT from Mining's METIS balance; unclaimable while paused (withdraw/deposit blocked).

DACRecorder_state.note: Reward vault METIS is separate from the Mining contract's balance.

governance_timeline.note: Only setPaused call in the contract's history (owner->Mining scan of all 16 admin txs). Contract has been paused since; no unpause. deposit/withdraw blocked, emergencyWithdraw enabled.

admin_surface_scan.note: Owner/setter have no function that transfers METIS out of the contract to themselves or an arbitrary address.

money_paths.effect: user.amount += _amount ONLY together with IERC20(pool.token).safeTransferFrom(_user, address(this), _amount); MIN_DEPOSIT=10e18, MAX_DEPOSIT=2000e18 enforced when DAC state Active
remaining = user.amount - _amount (SafeMath); user.amount = remaining; safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount) <= own recorded amount

money_paths.theft: no (recipient is the creator whose own amount is paid; requires DAO_OPEN)

money_paths.guards: require(paused) only; no DAC identity check

money_paths.effect: distributor.distribute(teamAddr, r/9) and distributor.distribute(DACRecorder, r) mint METIS; accMetisPerShare updated. Does not move Mining's METIS.

classic_bug_checklist.b_updatePool_before_actions: PASS (deposit L820, withdraw L880, dismissDAC L937)
classic_bug_checklist.d_overflow_underflow: SafeMath used throughout (solc 0.6.12 but all arithmetic wrapped); pending subtraction reverts on underflow (DoS risk only)
classic_bug_checklist.e_pendingMetis_wrong_accounting: view-only; DAC-weight based; capped by distributor balance; not used for state changes
classic_bug_checklist.f_DAC_membership_bypass: deposit onlyDAC; DAC.createDAC/joinDAC/increaseDeposit require Metis.allowance(msg.sender, Mining) >= amount and Mining pulls the METIS from the beneficiary via safeTransferFrom; joinDAC invitation-gated; no uncollateralized user.amount possible
classic_bug_checklist.g_zero_amount_deposit_farming: onlyDAC; sets rewardDebt = weight*share (harvest); no METIS leaves Mining
classic_bug_checklist.h_reentrancy: no guard; METIS is a plain ERC20 (no hooks); balance == sum(user.amount) exactly so no excess to double-spend; withdraw updates user.amount before transfer
classic_bug_checklist.i_teamAddr_distributor_redirect: owner-only setters; teamAddr=0; affects newly minted rewards only, not principal
classic_bug_checklist.j_paused_bypass: deposit/withdraw blocked while paused; emergencyWithdraw intentionally requires paused; no bypass
classic_bug_checklist.l_permissionless_METIS_movers: only emergencyWithdraw (own amount). No other function moves the contract's METIS.

source_audit.reward_source: distributor (0xD45Ad4eE...) mints METIS to DACRecorder; DACRecorder.sendRewardToVault transfers from DACRecorder's own balance (105,376.88 METIS) to the Vault for the user. Mining's own METIS is never used for rewards.

web_research.incident_search: No exploit/hack incident found for this contract; only user confusion reports about withdrawal after the Feb-2022 pause.

verdict.label: user principal held for stakers
verdict.stuck_caveat: Principal is retrievable by each of the 268 current stakers via emergencyWithdraw (contract paused since 2022-02-04). Normal withdraw/deposit are disabled and reward claims (paid by DACRecorder vault) are frozen while paused, but principal is not locked.
